== Notes ==

* Combat stats at level 20 (rank 5 or above): 
** It will normally do three attacks between Stoning with one cast every 6 seconds. However, it benefits from its staff's chance for half recharge time of spells 20% of the time. On these occasions it will complete its second normal attack at 2.625 seconds before casting Stoning again (see [[Activation Time]] and [[Attack speed]]). 
** Its normal attacks deal between 16 and 46 [[earth damage]] on targets with 60 armor, and can benefit from weapon spells.
** It has 15 in [[Earth Magic]].
** It has enough energy to use stoning 10 times during its lifespan, and will use it 9-10 times depending on the staff's recharge effect. As such, using a skill that reduces recharge time, like {{skill icon|Ebon Battle Standard of Wisdom}}, will not have any noticable effect unless combined with a skill that grants energy. 
* When the summon dies, it leaves a non-exploitable corpse. 
* The summoned Naga is ''not'' [[infused]] against [[Spectral Agony]].
* Its [[Stoning]] works best if one or more members of the party inflict [[Weakness]] on targets. However, it will not always cast the spell on weakened foes.
* It is considered a non-spirit ally.

{{anomaly|The description is misleading: you can have one active Asura Summon ''per player''.}}

== Trivia ==
* The summoned creature is a result of Asuran technology designed to imitate the creature it resembles
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
